snippet.title: DEBRISVERSE - Space Debris Crushing Rogue-lite [Official Trailer]
snippet.description:
DEBRISVERSE: A $100 million debt. Due date: NOW.
Shatter everything. Buy back your freedom.

■ Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4433730/DEBRISVERSE/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=pv1&utm_content=description

■ About the Game
DEBRISVERSE is a rogue-lite space debris-crushing simulation. Take control of a retro-futuristic spacecraft and clear the orbits of junk to repay a staggering $100 million debt to B.R.I.S. Corp.

■ Key Features
Satisfying Destruction: Obliterate massive fields of debris and trigger explosive chain reactions of credits.
Rogue-lite Progression: Choose from randomized upgrades. Focus on fire rate or raw power? Your choices dictate your repayment speed.
Strategic Cash Flow: Decide whether to reinvest earnings into ship upgrades or pay down your debt to unlock new functions.
Retro-Future Immersion: Experience a unique Lo-Fi aesthetic with a CRT-style UI, supported by your AI companion, "Briss-kun."

■ Product Info

Title: DEBRISVERSE
Genre: Space Debris Crushing / Rogue-lite Simulation
Platform: PC (Steam)
Release Date: 2026

Music： MusMus　https://musmus.main.jp/
　　　    DOVA-SYNDROME　https://dova-s.jp/
